question: I’m working on maintained status while my work permit extension is pending. If I travel abroad and return before approval, can I resume work on maintained status?
generated_answer: Yes, if you travel abroad and return before your work permit extension is approved, you can resume work on maintained status. Maintained status allows you to continue working in Canada while your application is being processed, as long as you meet the conditions of the status. However, it’s important to note that you should not leave Canada until your work permit extension is approved, as doing so may affect your ability to return and resume work on maintained status. It’s always best to consult with an immigration professional or the official government resources for the most accurate and up-to-date information.
